risks.why_it_matters: Pitch ownership is not fully proven at signoff granularity.
risks.recommended_future_action: Replace approximate placements with exact pitch-closed module assemblies.

risks.why_it_matters: Some routes still terminate on semantic contract pins rather than extracted signoff pin access shapes.
risks.recommended_future_action: Replace contract-backed route handoff with exact module pin geometry and LVS-aware naming.

risks.why_it_matters: Top-level straps are prototype geometry rather than verified signoff power distribution.
risks.recommended_future_action: Build explicit rail taps and continuity checks across all regions.

risks.why_it_matters: Prototype mapping evidence exists, but full detailed route closure is not demonstrated.
risks.recommended_future_action: Add detailed via, enclosure, spacing, and obstruction-aware routing closure.

risks.why_it_matters: Current power audit validates participation and prototype stitching only.
risks.recommended_future_action: Run real IR/EM-ready power verification after exact rail synthesis.

risks.why_it_matters: Geometry may still violate spacing or enclosure rules.
risks.recommended_future_action: Run DRC and feed violations into layout closure work rather than prototype assembly work.

risks.why_it_matters: Net-to-shape mapping evidence is not yet equivalent to extraction-verified LVS closure.
risks.recommended_future_action: Implement extractor-aligned net naming and compare against OpenYield semantic netlist.

risks.why_it_matters: Replica, WL, BL, and control path delays are not timing-closed.
risks.recommended_future_action: Add parasitic-aware timing characterization and close timing against SRAM specs.

risks.why_it_matters: Parameterization exists, but implementation evidence is only for a minimal 4x4 baseline.
risks.recommended_future_action: Re-run R3/R4/R5 on larger configs such as word_size=16 and num_words=32.

risks.why_it_matters: Current generator intent and prototype are scoped to single-bank single-port without write mask.
risks.recommended_future_action: Extend canonical intent, topology, and routing architecture before expanding feature scope.

risks.risk_name: OpenYield netlist-to-LVS extraction remains future work
risks.why_it_matters: Current mapping is audit evidence, not an extraction-ready LVS flow.
risks.recommended_future_action: Build a formal extraction handoff from GDS geometry to OpenYield semantic nets.
